_about: Hand-picked coverage set from the 11 Nov 2026 dictionary exploration: valid Slovene words of mixed rarity (incl. inflected and dual forms) and non-words (Croatian, English, made up). tools/build_lexicon.py reports coverage on it; tests/lexicon.test.js asserts it. ritaš moved to valid on 12 Nov 2026: it is a form of ritati (to kick).
